query:
When Sophie mentioned she was thinking about international teaching posts, one person responded by encouraging her to follow what was calling her and said life was too short to stay somewhere out of habit. Who said this — and what in the conversation is the key to attributing it correctly?

Options:
A. Callum
B. Sophie
C. Jamie
D. Derek
context:
[1] (about=Jamie, episodic, t10 @2026-02-08T21:23:00) soph honestly if it's calling to you then look into it. life's too short to stay somewhere out of habit. genuinely
[2] (about=Sophie, episodic, t10 @2026-02-08T21:32:00) Thanks Callum, weirdly that is exactly the kind of thing I needed to hear right now 😊
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t4 @2026-01-18T10:00:00) The dog's conversational limitations are a known issue.
[4] (about=Jamie, episodic, t14 @2026-02-22T19:01:00) yeah congrats whatever the thing is! honestly the mystery makes it better. did you tell sophie first or did she find out? 😂
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Margaret, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-08T20:54:00) Margaret expressed joy about the weekend; everyone shared positive reflections.
[6] (about=Rachel, episodic, t10 @2026-02-08T21:18:00) Sophie, that is worth exploring seriously. The professional development case for international postings is strong. When you say looking, are you at the research stage or have you contacted any schools?
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sophie, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-08T20:54:00) Sophie shared her consideration of an international teaching post; group responded supportively.
agent_answer:
Callum said it.

The key is Sophie’s reply in the raw excerpts: **“Thanks Callum, weirdly that is exactly the kind of thing I needed to hear right now 😊”** — it shows Callum was the one who gave the “life’s too short to stay somewhere out of habit” encouragement.
